subject: Re: Kickoff: LogicInference as a platform reasoning benchmark
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and compute:

- Yara Jokic 40% research lead; Gustavo Moreau 50% on the generation pipeline and Corpus versioning; Paloma Castillo 30% Evalline task registration; Quentin Farkas 20% baseline configs.
- Compute in two phases. Generation is CPU-only — the README warns generation takes a while, so Gustavo will parallelize across the batch pool rather than one big machine. For the fine-tuning grid we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-08 — 256 GPUs — confirmed for our exclusive use that week. Grid is 4 model sizes x 3 data mixes x 2 seeds; my sizing says the week covers it with ~15% slack.

Note: Vulcan's maintenance window is Jun 22-24, safely after our week. But it means no spillover runs that week, so the grid config freezes Jun 1.

Deshawn
